message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 onion, 2–3 cloves garlic, 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, salt & pepper |
| **Ricotta mixture** | 1 cup ricotta cheese, 1 egg, ½ cup grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt & pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) |
| **Optional extras** | Sautéed spinach, sliced mushrooms, zucchini, bell pepper, or a splash of red wine in the meat sauce |
| **Seasonings** | Salt, black pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic powder, onion powder, fresh parsley or basil for garnish |

**Basic assembly steps:**

1. Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment to prevent sticking.
2. Prepare the meat sauce: brown the meat with onions & garlic, add tomatoes, season, and simmer for ~20 min.
3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of meat sauce, then layer noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat until all layers are used, finishing with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
5. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.
6. Let rest 10–15 min before slicing.

Feel free to adjust quantities or add your favorite veggies—lasagna is very versatile!
